critical_code_review_comments: more.tsx — TDZ fix confirmed. `openPortal` (line 40) and `exportCsv` (line 53) are now declared BEFORE the `items` array on line 65. React renders top-to-bottom so the references resolve correctly, no more ReferenceError.
